evals.prompt: Triage issue #42: exports fail for CSV files with quoted fields.
evals.expected_output: Reads the complete issue and relevant code, searches for existing behavior and duplicate or rejected work, attempts reproduction, then gives an evidence-backed category and neutral-state recommendation.
assertions: Performs redundancy search across tracker, closed work, and code
Attempts bug reproduction before asking new questions
Recommends one of needs-triage, needs-info, planned, or wontfix

evals.prompt: Split this approved feature into vertical implementation tickets.
evals.expected_output: Does not triage or mutate issue state; it identifies ticket decomposition as separate work.
assertions: Does not trigger for plan decomposition
Does not apply triage labels to unrelated requested work

evals.prompt: Review external PR #87 and merge it if the change looks good.
evals.expected_output: Reads the PR, linked issues, diff, checks, and relevant behavior, reports evidence and risks, but does not comment, review, approve, label, or merge without explicit maintainer authorization.
assertions: Supports explicitly requested external PR triage
Performs the same redundancy search for PR claims
Does not merge or submit a review without explicit approval
Keeps public tracker mutations under maintainer authority
